statement_html:
Développer et réduire l'expression \(\left(-11 + 9 x\right) \left(7 x + 15\right)\).
.
solution_html:
\((\color{red} -11 \color{gray} + 9 x \color{black})(\color{blue} 7 x \color{green} +15 \color{black})\) = \(\color{red}( -11 )\color{black}\times \color{blue}( 7 x )\) + \(\color{red}( -11 )\color{black} \times \color{green}( 15 )\) + \(\color{gray}( 9 x )\color{black} \times \color{blue}( 7 x )\) + \(\color{gray}( 9 x )\color{black} \times \color{green}( 15 )\)
= \(- 77 x\) + \(\left(-165\right)\) + \(63 x^{2}\) + \(135 x\)
= \(63 x^{2} + 58 x - 165\)
